scripts.build:service: pnpm --filter @llm-spec/reporter build && pnpm --filter llm-spec build && pnpm --filter llm-spec copy:reporter
scripts.dev: concurrently -n watch,backend,reporter -c cyan,blue,green "pnpm --filter llm-spec build:watch" "pnpm --filter llm-spec dev:server" "pnpm --filter @llm-spec/reporter dev"
scripts.fetch-docs: pnpm --filter llm-spec build:scripts && pnpm --filter llm-spec fetch-docs
